title: How far do free models go on their own?
hypothesis: A free-only profile accepts at least 60% of scout, review and bulk tasks and at least 35% of code tasks.
human_gate: Frank approves publishing any oh-my-starlight pack.

runs_on.why: Free models cost nothing, so one arm at a time on the laptop is fine.

arms.model: opencode/* free models only, via enabled_providers

success_rule: Per class, the free profile is marketed for a class only if it reaches the thresholds in the hypothesis. Classes below threshold are documented as needing Token Pass.
kill: None needed, spend is zero. Stop after 12 tasks x 2 arms.

next_gate.receipt: lab/results/EXP-006.md class table; draft of the free profile

decision_it_feeds: What oh-my-starlight-free promises, and which classes it routes to Token Pass.
